local.description: Generate a locally administered MAC address (sets the local bit).

global.description: Generate a globally unique MAC address (clears the local bit).

unicast.description: Generate a unicast MAC address (clears the multicast bit).

multicast.description: Generate a multicast MAC address (sets the multicast bit).

oui_addr.description: Set the Organizationally Unique Identifier (OUI) explicitly (hex format, e.g., '00:11:22:33:44:55' or '001122334455'). Only set if vendor/qemu/xen are not used.

vendor.description: Set the OUI of a specific vendor by name or ID. Only set if other OUI options are not used.

qemu.description: Set the standard OUI of QEMU/KVM.

xen.description: Set the standard OUI of Xen.
